verdict.summary: The matched-workload harness is internally consistent and fail-closed. The generated replay is deterministically SHA-pinned; both engines receive the same replay path; runner-sourced oracle counts are independently recomputed before any timing rows are admitted; mismatches return a distinct failure and emit no rows. The focused comparator suite passes all 77 checks, including generator drift refusal, window bucketing equivalence, side-by-side labeling/caveats, and corrupted-oracle rejection. The Rust runner parses before timing, rejects malformed/unsorted input, and reports per-window counts without bypassing the comparator gate. Documentation honestly retains NOT-MEASURED status pending the external gather run. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was found in the diff.
